title: Road Hazard Protection and Manufacturing Defects
content:
Road Hazard Protection and the treadwear warranty's workmanship replacement are mutually exclusive for the same tire failure.

A tire that failed from a manufacturing defect — tread separation, out-of-round, belt shift, a bead leak on a sound wheel — has not met a road hazard. It is handled under the workmanship replacement of the Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty and uses none of the certificate's repairs, replacements or claim count. Only damage the technician records as one of the plan's covered damage types is a road hazard.

| Technician's finding | Road hazard? | Certificate repairs, replacements, claim count used |
|---|---|---|
| tread puncture, shoulder puncture, sidewall cut, impact break (and bead damage where the plan covers it) | yes | as the claim is booked |
| tread separation | no | none |
| out-of-round | no | none |
| belt shift | no | none |
| bead leak on a sound wheel | no | none |
